8                      UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT                      
9                 FOR THE EASTERN DISTRICT OF CALIFORNIA                 
10                                                                        
11   FRIENDS OF THE RIVER,           No.  2:16-cv-00818-DJC-JDP           
12                Plaintiff,                                              
13        v.                         ORDER                                
14   NATIONAL MARINE FISHERIES                                            
    SERVICE, et al.,                                                     
15                                                                        
                 Defendants.                                             
16                                                                        
17       Parties have filed a joint case management statement.  (ECF No. 155.)  Having 
18  review the positions of the parties, the Court will adopt a modified version of the 
19  schedule proposed by Federal Defendants.  Accordingly, IT IS HEREBY ORDERED 
20  that:                                                                 
21       1. No further joinder of parties or amendments to pleadings is permitted
22          without leave of the Court, good cause having been shown.  See Fed. R. Civ.
23          P.16(b); Johnson v. Mammoth Recreations, Inc., 975 F.2d 27 604 (9th Cir.
24          1992).                                                        
25       2. On or before February 21, 2025, Federal Defendants shall lodge with the
26          court supplements to the administrative record for the decisions challenged
27          by Plaintiff.  Federal Defendants shall simultaneously serve a copy of the
28          supplement to the administrative record on counsel for all parties.
1       3.  No later than March 14, 2025, the parties shall meet and confer to resolve 
2          any disputes as to the completeness of the administrative record, the 
3          applicability of any exceptions to record review, or any asserted need for 
4          judicial review of extra-record materials.                    
5       4.  On or before March 28, 2025, Plaintiff shall file any motion related to 
6          complete or supplement the administrative record that cannot be resolved 
7          by meet and confer efforts.                                   
8       5.  Motions for Summary Judgment shall be filed on the following schedule: 
9          a.  Plaintiff’s Motion for Summary Judgment shall be filed on or before April 
10            7, 2025;                                                    
11          b.  Defendants’ Opposition and Cross-Motion for Summary Judgment shall 
12            be filed on or before May 12, 2025;                         
13          c.  Defendant-Intervenor’s Opposition and Cross-Motion for Summary 
14            Judgment shall be filed on or before May 19, 2025;1         
15          d.  Plaintiff’s Opposition and Reply Shall be filed on or before June 16, 
16            2025;                                                       
17          e.  Defendants’ Reply shall be filed on or before July 7, 2025; and 
18          f.  Defendant-Intervenor’s Reply shall be filed on or before July 14, 2025. 
19       The Court does not, at this time, extend the page limit for cross-summary 
20  judgment motions.  However, should the parties jointly or separately believe that a 
21  more extensive page limit is necessary, the parties may request that the Court extend 
22  the page limits described in the Court’s Civil Standing Order.        
23                                                                        

24  Dated:  February 6, 2025        /s/ Daniel J. Calabretta              
                                   THE HONORABLE DANIEL J. CALABRETTA    
25                                                                        
                                   UNITED STATES DISTRICT JUDGE          
26                                                                        
27
